# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

**0.1.0** is the current release (OCaml **>= 4.14.1** and **< 5.4**;
CI tests **4.14.1** and **5.3.0**). Jane Street packages resolve to
v0.16 on 4.14 and v0.17 on 5.1–5.3.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report security issues privately via
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/david-engelmann/atproto/security/advisories)
on this repository. There are no known vulnerabilities in 0.1.0.
